basic_profile.bio: A tech enthusiast based in Seattle, WA, working as a software developer with a passion for open-source projects and privacy-focused technologies. I've been dabbling in electronics and mechanical tinkering since my teens, which naturally led me to explore various tech communities online. I'm an early riser, usually active on Reddit during the early mornings and late evenings. Happily married with two cats, I enjoy spending weekends hiking with my spouse and catching up on the latest MMORPGs.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science from the University of Washington, I've spent over a decade improving my skills in software development and cybersecurity. My knowledge is further bolstered by self-study and active participation in online communities centered around privacy tools and open-source software.
